thread/status/changed        │ event
turn/started                 │ event → turn_active
item/started                 │ event
item/completed               │ event
item/started                 │ event
item/completed               │ event
item/started                 │ event → tool_call_started commandExecution
item/completed               │ event → tool_call_ended
thread/status/changed        │ event @thread:thread-child
item/started                 │ event, link thread-root → thread-child (tool_call)
item/completed               │ event → task_started, link thread-root → thread-child (tool_call)
thread/status/changed        │ event @thread:thread-child
turn/started                 │ event @thread:thread-child → turn_active
item/started                 │ event
item/completed               │ event
thread/status/changed        │ event
turn/completed               │ event → turn_ended completed
item/started                 │ event @thread:thread-child
item/completed               │ event @thread:thread-child
thread/status/changed        │ event @thread:thread-child
turn/completed               │ event @thread:thread-child → turn_ended completed
item/started                 │ event, link thread-root → thread-child (tool_call)
item/completed               │ event → task_ended, link thread-root → thread-child (tool_call)
